text:
1. WHAT WORKED
   - The AI models, llama3.2:3b, mistral:7b-instruct-v0.3-q4_K_S, and phi3:mini, were able to process a significant number of tokens per second [E001, E002, E003].
   - Week-2 saw an increase in local Mistral analysis runs with 53 runs conducted [E004].
   - Human review was effective in correcting and approving the AI findings when performed [E005].
   - The OpenObserve trigger to AI-triage record showed a mean response time of 37.0 seconds over 4 alerts during historical replay [E007].
   - Week-3 automated triage and enrichment processes were implemented [E015].

2. WHAT DID NOT WORK
   - The manual quality scores for all AI models were low, with llama3.2:3b having a mean score of 1.77/5, mistral:7b-instruct-v0.3-q4_K_S scoring 2.77/5, and phi3:mini scoring 2.08/5 [E001, E002, E003].
   - The automatic keyword recall was not accurate for any of the AI models [E001, E002, E003].
   - Week-2 open gates such as human approval pending, HTTP evidence correlation, updated SIEM05 regression, replay scope, unified SOC candidate, no automatic remediation, and others remain unresolved [E009, E010, E011, E012, E013, E014, E015, E016, E017].
   - Cross-dataset overlaps were found in Week-4 correlation for IP addresses 183.62.140.253, 192.168.16.132, and 192.168.16.1 [E021, E022, E023].
   - Read-only checks in Week-4 revealed that 8 out of 16 T0 checks could not be answered from repository data [E024].
   - There is no live threat-intelligence feed, resulting in every indicator reputation being 'not checked' [E025].

3. AI ASSISTANCE LESSONS
   - Improve the accuracy of automatic keyword recall for all AI models.
   - Continue to monitor and improve the manual quality scores of AI models.

4. DETECTION AND VISIBILITY GAPS
   - Address the open gates from Week-2, including human approval pending, HTTP evidence correlation, updated SIEM05 regression, replay scope, unified SOC candidate, no automatic remediation, and others to improve detection and visibility.
   - Investigate and resolve cross-dataset overlaps found in Week-4 correlation.
   - Ensure all necessary data is available for read-only checks.
   - Implement a live threat-intelligence feed.

5. PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS
   - Continue to conduct regular benchmarking of AI models and make improvements based on the results.
   - Improve the efficiency of human review processes by addressing the open gates from Week-2.
   - Implement Week-3 SOAR and full incident response in future weeks.

6. OPEN ITEMS
   - Resolve the open gates from Week-2 as listed: human approval pending, HTTP evidence correlation, updated SIEM05 regression, replay scope, unified SOC candidate, no automatic remediation, and others.
   - Investigate and resolve cross-dataset overlaps found in Week-4 correlation.
   - Ensure all necessary data is available for read-only checks.
   - Implement a live threat-intelligence feed.

7. REVIEW STATUS: DRAFT - AI-generated, requires human analyst validation before use.
